changelog: **The mentorship request queue fits a 360px phone in German; the layout audit's calendar check follows #2153** (#2165). The mentor `<select>` in `/admin/mentorship`'s request queue is as wide as its longest option, and a mentor's option carries a translated availability note, so in German each row spilled ~200px past the viewport (`e2e/mobile-layout-audit.spec.ts` "admin screens … in German" red on `main`). `min-w-0 max-w-full` on the select and its action row let it shrink to the row. The reflow test located the calendar view switcher by `[role="tablist"]`, which #2153 removed — it now targets the new `data-testid="calendar-view-switcher"`. The mentor-screens case #2165 was filed for no longer reproduces on `main`; the whole audit spec is green again (8/8).
